mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.permission_code

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
